title: SunPower Warranty: A Guarantee for Greater Returns
summary: Learn how the SunPower warranty guarantees energy throughput, helping maximize battery performance, energy independence and solar value.
body_markdown:
Anyone investing in a battery storage system wants one thing above all else: long-term peace of mind. That’s exactly why SunPower offers a warranty that goes beyond conventional battery warranty models. Instead of limiting usage based on a maximum number of charge and discharge cycles, SunPower guarantees a specified energy throughput (MWh) over a 10-year period. This provides genuine investment security and can deliver significantly greater value over the lifetime of your system.


### What Makes the SunPower Warranty Different?


Many battery storage manufacturers advertise warranties based on a fixed number of charge and discharge cycles, such as 10,000 cycles over ten years. At first glance, this sounds attractive. However, there is one important catch: not every manufacturer defines a cycle in the same way.


With some battery systems, even a brief discharge followed by a recharge can be counted as a full cycle. This can happen when passing clouds temporarily reduce solar generation and the battery supplies power to your home before recharging again once solar production increases.


The result? Multiple charge and discharge cycles can accumulate within just a few hours, meaning your warranty's cycle limit may be reached much sooner than expected.


### No Cycle Limit – Just Guaranteed Energy Throughput


SunPower takes a different approach. Instead of basing its warranty on the number of charge and discharge cycles, it guarantees a total energy throughput (MWh), determined by the storage capacity of your battery system.


What this means for you:


✅ No restrictions based on a maximum number of charge cycles


✅ Clear and transparent warranty coverage


✅ Greater predictability for your investment


✅ Maximum utilisation of your self-generated solar energy


No matter how often your battery charges or discharges, the SunPower warranty remains reliable. You can use your stored solar energy with confidence, without worrying about cycle counts or hidden limitations.


*If you want to make the most of the energy generated by your solar panels, a SunPower battery storage system is the perfect solution.*


### Get More Value from Your Solar Energy


With a SunPower battery, you can use your self-generated solar power exactly when you need it. This increases your self-consumption, reduces your electricity bills, and helps protect you against rising energy costs.


Battery storage becomes even more valuable when combined with flexible electricity tariffs. Store excess solar energy, optimise your energy usage, and take advantage of favourable market conditions to maximise the value of every kilowatt-hour your system produces.


As a result, your solar installation can become more than just a sustainable energy solution—it can become a smart investment that delivers faster payback and long-term financial benefits.


### Conclusion: A Warranty You Can Rely On


While many battery warranties are based on a limited number of charge cycles, SunPower's guaranteed energy throughput model offers a more transparent and customer-focused alternative. The result is greater security, increased flexibility, and improved confidence in your investment.


If you want to unlock the full potential of your solar energy system, the SunPower battery storage solution is the ideal addition to your solar installation.
